proof_nl: Let x be any real number. By the definition of the fractional-part function frac, frac(x) is the difference between x and the greatest integer less than or equal to x, namely floor(x). Therefore frac(x) = x - floor(x).
solver_summary: Immediate from the definition of the fractional part.
vetter_reason: The proof directly restates the standard definition of fractional part and concludes frac(x) = x - floor(x). It matches the lemma exactly, with no gap or drift.
